body: Brussels Airport (BRU) expects major flight disruption on November 23, after some air traffic controllers at Belgian air navigation service provider skeyes said they would join a national demonstration. The airport said most arriving and departing flights will have to be cancelled because skeyes will not be able to provide normal air traffic control services during the action, with disruption expected from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. local time (6 a.m. to 8 p.m. UTC).

According to skeyes, the expected number of staff would not be enough to safely handle regular air traffic during the strike. It will therefore temporarily suspend normal services at Belgian airports and in the airspace under its responsibility, while minimum services will be maintained for emergency and other safety-critical flights. Brussels Airport said airlines will contact affected passengers directly, and flight cancellations will appear on the airport's website once they have been registered by the carriers.

Brussels South Charleroi Airport (CRL) also expects flights to stop: no flights will be able to take off or land between 7 a.m. and 9 p.m. on the same day because air traffic control will not be available. The airport said it had arranged staffing to keep its own operations running while respecting employees' right to join the demonstration, but without air traffic control, aircraft cannot operate safely. CRL warned that the late notice would affect thousands of passengers, airlines and around 3,400 people working at the airport, criticised the short notice and called for a coordinated plan to protect Belgian airport operations.

The national demonstration has been called by Belgium's main trade unions to protest against the federal government's economic and social policies. The unions oppose planned budget cuts and reforms that they say could put more pressure on workers, pensioners and people who rely on social support, with concerns including purchasing power, pensions, social security, employment conditions and public services. The demonstration is planned in Brussels, where participants are expected to march through the city. Passengers scheduled to travel from or to Brussels or Charleroi on November 23 should check their flight status directly with their airline before leaving for the airport, and public transport in Belgium may also be affected.
en.summary: Air traffic controllers at Belgian provider skeyes will join a national demonstration on November 23, leaving Brussels and Charleroi airports without normal air traffic control from 7 a.m. to 9 p.m. and forcing most flights to be cancelled.
en.title: Belgian strike to ground most flights at Brussels and Charleroi airports on November 23

body: 據AeroTime報導，布魯塞爾機場（BRU）預計11月23日出現大規模航班中斷。比利時飛航服務商skeyes部分航管人員將加入全國示威，skeyes屆時無法提供正常飛航管制服務，機場表示多數進出港航班必須取消，中斷時間為當地時間7時至21時。
skeyes表示，預計到班人力不足以安全處理正常空中交通，因此將暫停比利時各機場及所轄空域的正常服務，僅維持緊急與其他攸關安全的最低限度服務。布魯塞爾機場表示，航空公司將直接聯繫受影響旅客，航班取消資訊會在航空公司登記後顯示於機場網站。
沙勒羅瓦機場（CRL）同樣受到影響，機場表示11月23日7時至21時之間沒有航班能夠起降，因為該時段沒有飛航管制服務。機場表示已安排人力維持自身運作，同時尊重員工參與示威的權利，但沒有飛航管制，飛機無法安全運作。機場警告，通知時間倉促，將影響數千名旅客、各航空公司及機場約3400名工作人員，並批評通知過晚，呼籲制定協調計畫保障比利時機場運作。

這場全國示威由比利時主要工會發起，抗議聯邦政府的經濟與社會政策。工會反對可能加重勞工、退休人員與仰賴社會扶助者負擔的預算削減與改革，關注議題包括購買力、退休金、社會保障、就業條件與公共服務。示威計畫在布魯塞爾舉行，參與者預計在市區遊行。機場提醒，預定11月23日往返布魯塞爾或沙勒羅瓦的旅客出發前應先向航空公司確認航班狀態，除非已獲確認，否則不應假設航班會正常運作；比利時公共運輸也可能受到影響，旅客應一併確認前往機場的交通。
zh.summary: 比利時飛航服務商skeyes人員將加入11月23日全國示威，布魯塞爾機場與沙勒羅瓦機場當日7時至21時無法提供正常飛航管制服務，多數航班須取消。
zh.title: 比利時全國示威衝擊航班：布魯塞爾與沙勒羅瓦機場11月23日多數航班取消
